# Event catalogue

Payloads come from `harness.sdk.events.EVENT_PAYLOADS` (the same dataclasses that produce `docs/events.schema.json`). `Producers` is a heuristic scan for the literal event type. `Client renderer` names the shipped web module that subscribes; `none (live only)` means the event is on the bus but the web client does not paint it (it may still drive the CLI or a card).

`In the log` is the WS-04 contract: `record: <kind>` means the event mirrors a transcript record of that kind and may carry it on `Event.record`, so a reload re-renders it from the log; `transient` marks streamed or derived events that no replay may depend on; `—` is a kernel fact that was never part of a conversation.
